source.claimText: A compound having the following structure (IG): [chem] or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or stereoisomer thereof, wherein: R1 and R2 are each independently C6-C24 alkyl or C6-C24 alkenyl; R3 is OR5, CN, -C(=O)OR4, -OC(=O)R4 or -NR5C(=O)R4; R4 is C1-C12 alkyl; R5 is H or C1-C6 alkyl; R6 is, at each occurrence, H; n is an integer ranging from 2 to 12; and y and z are each independently an integer ranging from 6 to 9.

core.note: Structure (IG): R1-C(=O)O-(CH2)y-N[-(CHR6)n-R3]-(CH2)z-OC(=O)-R2. R6 is H at each occurrence, so the n unit is CH2. R3 is an expanded group because OR5 / C(=O)OR4 carry further variables.

vars.name: R1
vars.quote: R1 and R2 are each independently C6-C24 alkyl or C6-C24 alkenyl
vars.note: Alkyl / alkenyl substitution is defined in the description, not in the claim: chains with hetero atoms are reported unclear.

vars.name: y
vars.quote: y and z are each independently an integer ranging from 6 to 9

vars.name: n
vars.quote: n is an integer ranging from 2 to 12
vars.note: R6 is, at each occurrence, H: the repeat unit is CH2.

vars.name: z
vars.quote: y and z are each independently an integer ranging from 6 to 9

vars.name: R2
vars.quote: R1 and R2 are each independently C6-C24 alkyl or C6-C24 alkenyl

vars.name: R5
vars.quote: R5 is H or C1-C6 alkyl

ref.name: ALC-0315
ref.note: y = z = 6, n = 4, R3 = OH (OR5 with R5 = H), R1 = R2 = pentadecan-7-yl (C15 branched; the ester acyl is 2-hexyldecanoyl)
